Land Acquisition and Relocation
An immediate impact of this proposed highway improvement program will be the displacement of people and buildings due to the transfer of privately owned lands to public ownership. With this in mind, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation and the legislature have initiated a Pelocation Assistance Program which seeks to minimize the inconvenience to the individuals concerned. Coordination with the City of Milwaukee and Milwaukee County will insure that replacement housing is available to the extent that may be required. Pepresentatives of these agencies will be in close communication with the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) concerning replacement housing resources.
The Division of Highways, under both state and federal laws, has the principle responsibility of providing assistance to those persons, businesses, non-profit organizations, and others who may be relocated as a result of the acquisition of lands for public highway improvements.
